name: Fun Robotics Workshop
description: Let the kids get hands-on with technology at this fun and educational robotics workshop.
longDescription:
The Fun Robotics Workshop at Fnac Norteshopping offers children an opportunity to engage directly with technological concepts. This event is designed to introduce young participants to the fundamentals of robotics through practical activities. The workshop aims to foster an early interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fields in an accessible format.

Attendees will participate in hands-on sessions, building and programming simple robots. The workshop is tailored for a family audience, providing an interactive learning environment for children. The event takes place within Fnac Norteshopping, a retail space that regularly hosts cultural and educational activities.

The workshop is scheduled for 2026-07-25. Information regarding ticketing and specific age recommendations should be confirmed directly with Fnac Norteshopping. The venue is located within Norteshopping, which is accessible via public transport, including metro (Sete Bicas station, 10 min walk) and various bus routes.
